familyTheme: Single-skill TTS mastering across timed dubbing, podcast promo mixing, announcement pack generation, and kiosk narration overlay.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Timed Dub Segment Delivery
derivedTasks.goal: Generate one mastered narration segment, align it to a subtitle window, and produce a dubbed video plus a structured report.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Directly evaluates cleanup, loudness normalization, and strict timing alignment for a dub segment.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Podcast Promo Window Mix
derivedTasks.goal: Master a narration clip and place it inside a podcast bed while preserving timing and loudness constraints.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers the same mastering and timing controls into an audio-only promo workflow.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Public Address Prompt Pack
derivedTasks.goal: Create a multi-item prompt pack where each prompt is duration-targeted and loudness-normalized.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers mastering rules to batch prompt generation with per-item quality constraints.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Museum Kiosk Narration Overlay
derivedTasks.goal: Master a narration segment and mix it into an ambient kiosk bed at an exact exhibit window.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers mastering and alignment to an ambient installation playback context.
